Leaker Evan Blass has just posted, claiming that the iPhone Ultra will come in three colors, including a surprising red.

Update: Mark Gurman has posted on X that the iPhone Ultra will not come in a red option, directly contradicting Blass's claim. Original story below.

Evan Blass claims iPhone Ultra could come in red

With Apple's event officially confirmed for September 9, rumors about its new flagship iPhone continue to swirl. The latest concerns the colors for the foldable iPhone Ultra.

There's already general consensus about what colors the iPhone 18 Pro will come in, including a bold dark cherry/burgundy, light blue, silver, and possibly space gray.

But the iPhone Ultra may only come in black and white, or even just white, according to rumors.

However, leaker Evan Blass has posted on X claiming that a red option will also be among them.

The image above appears to be AI-generated. For instance, there are inconsistencies in the iOS 27 status bar, which uses the battery icon design from the older iOS 26.

Still, even if the image was most likely AI-generated, that doesn't necessarily mean the colors are wrong.

We're skeptical, as there have been no previous reliable rumors about a red option for the iPhone Ultra. It would also be unusual for both flagship models to come in red. So take this rumor with a grain of salt.

Whatever Apple has prepared, we'll find out in just two weeks.

What do you think of the rumored iPhone Ultra colors? Let us know in the comments.
